item.title: Rahul Gandhi speaks to IIT-B student Sahil Wakode’s parents
item.description: Rahul Gandhi held a video call with Sahil Wakode's parents to offer support after their son's death. Sahil, a second-year BTech student, was found dead shortly after an exam incident. His parents allege caste-based discrimination and are seeking action against those responsible. Protests are ongoing demanding an independent investigation into his death.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: After Jamui, another girl molested on camera in Bihar; 4 nabbed
item.description: In Samastipur, four men were arrested after a video surfaced showing them allegedly harassing a girl in public. The incident occurred on Dam Bypass Road when the girl and a boy stopped to take photographs. Similar incidents had recently taken place in Jamui, where a Class X girl faced harassment from a group of youths. The Jamui police detained three minors and identified more suspects from video footage.
item.dc:creator: SHREEDHAR RATHI

item.title: Inside China’s nuclear buildup: New activity spotted across 7 sites
item.description: China is rapidly advancing its nuclear weapons program with ongoing construction and upgrades at various strategic facilities nationwide. Notable developments have been observed in Pingtong, Zitong, and especially Lop Nur. The Federation of American Scientists reports an estimated 620 nuclear warheads, hinting at potential future production to support new delivery systems. Despite these advancements, Chinese officials emphasize their commitment to a defensive nuclear posture and a no-first-use policy.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: 'I couldn't sleep': Gambhir on 'toughest decision' to drop Sanju for Sooryavanshi
item.description: Gautam Gambhir shared the tough emotional burden he encountered while dropping Sanju Samson from India's T20I squad after their defeat against England. Despite previous strong performances from Samson, Gambhir stressed the necessity of evaluating player form and ensuring a cohesive team dynamic. Samson was later reintegrated into the lineup, showcasing his talent in the series against Afghanistan.
item.dc:creator: PRANAV SHUKLA

item.title: Anthropic’s Claude finds new CRISPR-like system in viruses
item.description: Anthropic says its Claude AI has discovered ART, a previously uncharacterised enzyme system in bacteriophages with a CRISPR-like repeat array. Around 950 Claude agents searched DNA data for 21 hours to find it. CEO Dario Amodei says its function and significance aren't clear yet, but calls it work he would have been proud to do as a PhD student. CRISPR pioneer Feng Zhang says it merits further study.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: 'Gyanesh, it's done bro': CJP to take up issue of EC reforms as CEC draws flak
item.description: Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) has shifted its focus to electoral reforms following issues with the Election Commission. CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke expressed concerns regarding the integrity of voting rights amid allegations of compromised elections. The organization aims to protect the right to vote, emphasizing the importance of elections for systemic change. Recent reports indicated internal objections within the Election Commission concerning voter registration processes.
item.dc:creator: HADI KHAN

item.title: 9 killed after sleeper bus catches fire on Yamuna Expressway
item.description: A sleeper bus registered in Bihar caught fire on the Yamuna Expressway near Noida International Airport. There were approximately 35 passengers on board, with many managing to escape through windows. Panic ensued as the bus filled with smoke, making it difficult for passengers to escape. Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath offered condolences to the victims' families and ordered medical assistance for the injured.
item.dc:creator: ADVITYA BAHL

item.title: In 2020, Katy Perry got a $15 M home; landed ownership after 5 year legal battle
item.description: In July 2020, Katy Perry signed a deal to acquire a luxurious USD 15 million mansion in Montecito. The transaction took a twist when the seller, Carl Westcott, retracted and filed a lawsuit questioning the contract's validity and his mental fitness after surgery. Following court proceedings, the judge ruled in favor of Perry, securing her ownership and granting her damages and legal costs from the ongoing dispute.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: DoorDash agrees to $131.5m after payment errors affected 200,000-plus NYC workers
item.description: DoorDash will pay $131.5 million to settle a probe regarding its payment practices for delivery workers. The settlement will directly benefit over 260,000 Dashers, addressing both missing and late payments. An additional dispute over calculation methods for on-call pay times has also been resolved in this agreement. DoorDash has acknowledged the issues caused by technical errors and improved its payment processes.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Man shares how a one-in-a-billion sea encounter led him to his father
item.description: In an extraordinary twist of fate, Rusheel Saran unexpectedly met his father, Raviraj Saran, while navigating the vast North Atlantic. Each man was aboard different vessels, heading in opposite directions, yet their paths crossed in the middle of the ocean, far from any shore. This spontaneous reunion became a heartfelt moment shared online, prompting emotional reactions and admiration from viewers around the world during their extensive maritime journeys.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: Ram temple theft: Cash siphoned during counting, says 70k-page chargesheet
item.description: On Wednesday, an extensive chargesheet was filed by the Supreme Court-mandated Special Investigation Team regarding the Ayodhya case. The document lists eight individuals arrested for allegedly embezzling temple donations, with investigators uncovering a staggering Rs 79.85 lakh in cash linked to these crimes. The SIT meticulously analyzed bank accounts and evaluated the worth of donated items to scrutinize the financial discrepancies around the temple's funding.
item.dc:creator: PATHIKRIT CHAKRABORTY

item.title: LeBron James’ daughter Zhuri inspires Savannah James’ latest business venture
item.description: Savannah James has invested in the LOVB Los Angeles volleyball team. Her daughter Zhuri's passion for the sport inspired this significant personal investment. This move supports Zhuri and promotes women's volleyball growth. Savannah joins Alexis Ohanian and Issa Rae in this new ownership group. The team is set to begin its inaugural season in 2026-27.

item.title: 'Bigger deal' on table: US, China extend trade truce by two months
item.description: The United States and China have decided to extend their trade agreement until January 10. This extension follows a series of discussions between US treasury secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese vice-premier He Lifeng. The truce allows both countries to evaluate China's compliance with trade commitments while discussing broader agreements. Meetings will address various issues, including artificial intelligence and Taiwan relations.
item.dc:creator: PRISHA PATNAIK

item.title: Cut in 9 pieces & a wife missing: What we know about K'taka man's death in UAE
item.description: The family of Alwin Prakash Kunder is requesting a thorough investigation into his alleged murder. Alwin's dismembered body was discovered in the UAE after he reportedly went missing in July. His wife Tina and their son are currently untraceable, raising concerns about their safety. The victim's brother has documented the circumstances surrounding Alwin's death but lacks a copy of the FIR.

item.title: Video: Ex-Patna municipal councillor shot at by unidentified assailants
item.description: In a shocking incident, Anil Yadav, a former councillor in Patna, was ambushed and shot by three unidentified gunmen in the basement of his residence around 7:30 PM, located in Buddha Colony. Following the attack, the perpetrators fled the scene while Yadav was quickly transported to a private hospital, where it was revealed he endured multiple bullet injuries. Authorities have since activated a manhunt to catch the assailants.
item.dc:creator: HADI KHAN

item.title: His staff had no pension, so he invested ₹25,000 each for their future
item.description: Naresh realized his driver and maid lacked retirement benefits and decided to take action for their future. He invested ₹25,000 in Kisan Vikas Patra for each worker, amounting to a total of ₹50,000. This investment is set to double in about 9 years and 7 months under current terms. Naresh aims to raise awareness about long-term financial security among household workers and considers additional contributions.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: Kalkaji gang-rape: Police probe if Aastha Kunj park was hunting ground of accused
item.description: In a disturbing incident at Aastha Kunj park, a 17-year-old girl was allegedly raped by three men. The victims were sitting peacefully when the men, posing as policemen, approached them. They threatened the male companion and took the girl to a dark area of the park. After the assault, the girl was warned against reporting the crime to anyone.

item.title: Watch: RAF Hawk T2 crashes and explodes near airbase in Wales
item.description: A training mission took a dangerous turn on Wednesday when an RAF Hawk T2 aircraft crashed shortly after taking off from RAF Valley. Fortunately, both pilots safely ejected and sustained only minor injuries. Technical issues arose during ascent, causing the aircraft to plunge dramatically before landing in Pencarnisiog. Emergency services acted swiftly to extinguish the fire and secure the area, while the RAF has paused Hawk operations pending further investigation.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: Musician Peter Byrne passes away at 74
item.description: On September 14, Peter Byrne, co-founder of Naked Eyes, died at the age of 74 following a brief illness, at his residence in Los Angeles. A prominent figure in the new wave and synth-pop genres since the early '80s, he is remembered by his siblings, three children, and ex-wife Elena. Over his varied career, Byrne collaborated with many artists, including the legendary Stevie Wonder.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: What if Yellowstone erupts? What would happen to the US and the world
item.description: The prospect of a supervolcano eruption at Yellowstone National Park heralds dire consequences on multiple fronts. Experts predict detectable signs, such as seismic activity and ground shifts, prior to any eruption event. This would necessitate evacuations for nearly 200,000 individuals, both locals and tourists, leading to significant turmoil. An ash cloud would ensue, disrupting transport and agricultural sectors for considerable periods.

item.title: She trained disguised as a man, fled the Taliban and won Asian Games silver
item.description: Fariba Hashimi and her sister Yulduz encountered significant challenges while training to become cyclists in Afghanistan. Their talent was recognized after they excelled in local competitions, earning them a chance to join the national team. After their escape to Italy, Fariba's remarkable achievement of winning a silver medal at the Asian Games signified a breakthrough for Afghan women, representing hope and perseverance against Taliban restrictions.
